summary: Friedberg argues Google's I/O conference marked a genuine pivot into AI-first search and a new subscription business model, potentially representing the week Google truly entered the AI era.
quote: I would say if anyone were to identify the week that Google really pivoted into the AI business model, it might be this week. They launched over 15 products at this thing.

summary: Chamath is excited about the IO/Jony Ive acquisition and believes OpenAI may be building a genuinely world-changing next-generation device, drawing a parallel to the transformative first iPhone moment.
quote: I'm surprised that you guys are such haters on this. I'm excited to see what this thing is... They've invented something that they say is world-changing.

summary: Friedberg argues the weak Treasury auction and rising 30-year yields above 5% — well above the CBO's 3.6% assumption — create a nonlinear, recursive debt spiral that could trigger a cataclysmic global credit unraveling if the Big Beautiful Bill passes as-is.
quote: There is a nonlinear relationship between the deficit and interest rates, which drives up the debt problem in a nonlinear way, and it gets away from you and you can't fix it. And that's what the market is telling us.

summary: Chamath warns that the bond market will re-underwrite US debt at real rates of 5–5.5% (not the CBO's 3.6%), triggering a decisive sell-off in US Treasuries; he says he will put his money on that outcome.
quote: I'll put my money where my mouth is and I'll put the chips on the table to say this is the moment... the bond markets will act decisively and they're going to go in one direction and it's away from us.

summary: Chamath identifies Bitcoin as a beneficiary of rising US yields and fiscal deterioration, noting it has already begun spiking alongside gold as investors flee US debt.
quote: You'll delever from the United States, you'll sell US debt. You'll own things like gold and Bitcoin. If you're curious about what's happening to gold and Bitcoin, they started to spike in the last few days.
